scenario: Pripravujem sa na skúšku zo slovenčiny
text: Zajtra mám skúšku zo slovenčiny, preto sa veľmi učím. Ráno si sadnem k stolu a opakujem slovíčka. Učím sa gramatiku a snažím sa pochopiť pravidlá. Občas si robím prestávku a dám si kávu. Verím si, že skúšku zvládnem dobre.
textEn: Tomorrow I have a Slovak exam, so I am studying hard. In the morning I will sit down at the table and review vocabulary. I am learning grammar and trying to understand the rules. Sometimes I take a break and have a coffee. I believe in myself that I will handle the exam well.

text: Tento týždeň je veľmi chladné počasie. Vonku musím nosiť teplý kabát každý deň. Nechcem chodiť von, keď prší. Môžeme zostať doma a pozerať filmy. Zajtra chce byť teplejšie, tak sa teším.
textEn: This week the weather is very cold. Outside I must wear a warm coat every day. I don't want to go outside when it rains. We can stay home and watch movies. Tomorrow it wants to be warmer, so I am looking forward to it.

scenarioEn: a weekend trip to the mountains
text: Minulý víkend sme išli s priateľmi do hôr. Ubytovali sme sa v malom hoteli pri lese. Ráno sme chodili na túry a obdivovali krásnu prírodu. Večer sme sedeli pred krbom a rozprávali sa o zážitkoch. Bol to výborný víkend za mestom.
textEn: Last weekend we went with friends to the mountains. We stayed in a small hotel near the forest. In the morning we went on hikes and admired the beautiful nature. In the evening we sat in front of the fireplace and talked about experiences. It was an excellent weekend outside the city.

scenarioEn: a weekend trip to the mountains
text: Cez víkend ideme s priateľmi do hôr. Vstávame skoro ráno a nesieme si ruksaky. V horách chodíme po chodníkoch a vidíme krásnu prírodu. Večer jeme teplú polievku pri ohni. Všetci sú unavení, ale šťastní.
textEn: Over the weekend we go to the mountains with friends. We get up early in the morning and carry our backpacks. In the mountains we walk on trails and see beautiful nature. In the evening we eat warm soup by the fire. Everyone is tired but happy.

text: Johanna sedí pri svojom stole a píše email rodičom. Píše o svojom živote v novom meste. Hovorí o kamarátoch a svojej izbe. Je veľmi spokojná so svojím životom tu. Rodičia sa tešia na jej správu.
textEn: Johanna sits at her desk and writes an email to her parents. She writes about her life in the new city. She talks about her friends and her room. She is very happy with her life here. Her parents look forward to her message.

scenarioEn: Johanna's morning routine at the student dormitory
text: Johanna býva v internáte blízko univerzity. Ráno vstáva o siedmej hodine a ide do kúpeľne. Raňajkuje s kamarátkami v jedálni na prízemí. Pred vyučovaním si balí tašku a pije kávu.
textEn: Johanna lives in a dormitory near the university. In the morning she gets up at seven o'clock and goes to the bathroom. She has breakfast with her friends in the canteen on the ground floor. Before class she packs her bag and drinks coffee.

scenarioEn: Zuzana and Johanna at a café
text: Zuzana a Johanna sú v malej kaviarni. Káva je horúca, ale koláč je studený. Johanna chce veľký pohár vody a Zuzana chce malý čaj. Čašníčka je milá a rýchla, nie pomalá. Dievčatá sú spokojné a šťastné.
textEn: Zuzana and Johanna are in a small café. The coffee is hot, but the cake is cold. Johanna wants a big glass of water and Zuzana wants a small tea. The waitress is kind and fast, not slow. The girls are satisfied and happy.

text: Dnes ráno som čakal v čakárni dve hodiny. V čakárni bolo päť pacientov. Lekár mi predpísal tri lieky. Musím ich užívať štyri dni. Sestra mi zmerala teplotu dvakrát.
textEn: This morning I waited in the waiting room for two hours. There were five patients in the waiting room. The doctor prescribed me three medicines. I have to take them for four days. The nurse took my temperature twice.

scenario: Róbert sa sťahuje do nového bytu
scenarioEn: Róbert moving to a new flat
text: Róbert sa dnes sťahuje do nového bytu. Nesie ťažké krabice a veľmi sa unavuje. Jeho priateľ mu pomáha a spolu pracujú celý deň. Róbert chce bývať v tomto byte sám. Večer si sadajú a jedia pizzu.
textEn: Róbert is moving to a new flat today. He is carrying heavy boxes and getting very tired. His friend helps him and they work together all day. Róbert wants to live in this flat alone. In the evening they sit down and eat pizza.

text: Konferencia začala o deviatej ráno. Na obede sme sa stretli pol dvanástej. Popoludní bol zaujímavý workshop štvrť na tri. Večera bola o siedmej hodine. Domov som išiel až o desiatej večer.
textEn: The conference started at nine in the morning. At lunch we met at half past eleven. In the afternoon there was an interesting workshop at a quarter to three. Dinner was at seven o'clock. I went home only at ten in the evening.

text: Marianna varí večeru pre svojich priateľov. V kuchyni pracuje s nožom a panvicou. Pripravuje polievku so zeleninou a kuracie mäso. Priateľom sa páči vôňa z kuchyne. Sedia pri stole a čakajú s radosťou.
textEn: Marianna is cooking dinner for her friends. In the kitchen she works with a knife and a pan. She is preparing soup with vegetables and chicken meat. The friends like the smell from the kitchen. They sit at the table and wait with joy.

text: Ráno som šiel k lekárovi s vysokou horúčkou. Lekár sa ma spýtal na moje problémy a prezrel ma. Napísal mi recept na lieky a odporučil mi odpočinok. Celý deň som ležal v posteli a pil čaj. Cítil som sa lepšie až večer.
textEn: In the morning I went to the doctor with a high fever. The doctor asked me about my problems and examined me. He wrote me a prescription for medicine and recommended rest. I lay in bed all day and drank tea. I felt better only in the evening.

text: V mojej triede sú študenti z rôznych krajín. Môj spolužiak Carlos už prišiel zo Španielska minulý rok. Jana ešte neštudovala v zahraničí, ale chce ísť do Francúzska. Tomáš ešte nehovoril po nemecky, keď začal školu. Naša učiteľka už učila cudzincov predtým.
textEn: In my class there are students from various countries. My classmate Carlos already came from Spain last year. Jana had not yet studied abroad, but she wants to go to France. Tomáš had not yet spoken German when he started school. Our teacher had already taught foreigners before.

text: Dnes je studená a daždivá sobota v Bratislave. Vonku je škaredé a tmavé počasie. Ulice sú mokré a prázdne. Jana sedí doma pri teplom čaji a číta zaujímavú knihu. Je rada, že nemusí ísť von.
textEn: Today is a cold and rainy Saturday in Bratislava. Outside the weather is ugly and dark. The streets are wet and empty. Jana sits at home with warm tea and reads an interesting book. She is glad she does not have to go outside.

scenarioEn: Zuzana and Johanna at a café
text: Zuzana a Johanna sa stretnú v kaviarni o pol jedenástej. Johanna príde o štvrť na jedenásť, teda skôr. Kaviareň sa otvorí o deviatej ráno. Odídu domov o pol druhej poobede. Nabudúce sa stretnú o štvrtej.
textEn: Zuzana and Johanna will meet at a café at half past ten. Johanna will come at a quarter to eleven, so earlier. The café opens at nine in the morning. They will leave for home at half past one in the afternoon. Next time they will meet at four o'clock.

scenario: pripravujem sa na skúšku zo slovenčiny
text: Zajtra mám skúšku zo slovenčiny. Celý večer sedím pri stole a učím sa nové slová. Cvičím gramatiku so spolužiačkou. Píšem poznámky červenou perou. Dúfam, že na skúške budem úspešný.
textEn: Tomorrow I have a Slovak exam. I sit at the table all evening and learn new words. I practice grammar with a classmate. I write notes with a red pen. I hope that I will be successful at the exam.

text: Zajtra má moja sestra narodeniny. Idem do obchodu kúpiť jej darček. Chcem kúpiť knihu o varení. Zaplatím za darček pätnásť eur. Potom pôjdem s darčekom domov.
textEn: Tomorrow is my sister's birthday. I'm going to the store to buy her a present. I want to buy a book about cooking. I will pay fifteen euros for the present. Then I will go home with the present.

scenario: víkend u starých rodičov na dedine
text: Minulý víkend sme išli k starým rodičom na dedinu. Babička nám uvarila výbornú polievku a dedko išiel do záhrady. Celý deň sme pracovali na poli a večer sme jedli spolu. Bol som veľmi unavený, ale cítil som sa dobre.
textEn: Last weekend we went to our grandparents' village. Grandma cooked us an excellent soup and grandpa went to the garden. All day we worked in the field and in the evening we ate together. I was very tired but I felt good.

text: Johanna sedí pri počítači a píše email domov. Ešte nikdy nepísala také dlhé správy. Nikomu inému nič nehovorí o svojich problémoch. V emaili nespomína nič zlé, len dobré veci. Nikto iný nevie, čo cíti vo svojom srdci.
textEn: Johanna sits at the computer and writes an email home. She has never written such long messages before. She tells nobody else anything about her problems. In the email she mentions nothing bad, only good things. Nobody else knows what she feels in her heart.

text: Dnes ráno som čakal na vlak na stanici. Vlak mal prísť o deviatej, ale neprišiel načas. Sadol som si na lavičku a čítal som knihu. Potom som sa opýtal pokladníčky, kde je vlak. Ona odpovedala, že vlak mešká hodinu.
textEn: This morning I was waiting for a train at the station. The train was supposed to arrive at nine, but it did not come on time. I sat down on a bench and read a book. Then I asked the ticket lady where the train was. She answered that the train was delayed by an hour.

scenario: Róbertov prvý deň v novej firme
scenarioEn: Róbert's first day at a new company
text: Dnes ráno prišiel Róbert do novej firmy. Predstavil sa kolegom a hovoril s riaditeľom o práci. Sedel pri stole pred počítačom a písal správy. Na obede bol so spolupracovníkmi v reštaurácii. Prvý deň v novej práci mu prešiel rýchlo.
textEn: This morning Róbert arrived at the new company. He introduced himself to his colleagues and spoke with the director about work. He sat at the desk in front of the computer and wrote messages. At lunch he was with his coworkers in a restaurant. His first day at the new job passed quickly.

scenario: Mišo kupuje nábytok do svojej izby
scenarioEn: Mišo buying furniture for his room
text: Mišo chce zariadiť svoju novú izbu. Ide do obchodu a hľadá stolík a posteľ. Predavač mu pomáha vybrať správny nábytok. Mišo kupuje aj malú skriňu. Doma všetko starostlivo ukladá na svoje miesto.
textEn: Mišo wants to furnish his new room. He goes to the shop and looks for a small table and a bed. The shop assistant helps him choose the right furniture. Mišo also buys a small wardrobe. At home he carefully puts everything in its place.

text: Ráno som sa necítil dobre, preto som šiel k lekárovi. V čakárni som si sadol a čakal som dlho. Lekár sa ma opýtal, čo ma bolí. Potom som si musel vyzliecť košeľu. Lekár mi povedal, aby som sa dobre staral o zdravie.
textEn: In the morning I did not feel well, so I went to the doctor. In the waiting room I sat down and waited a long time. The doctor asked me what hurt me. Then I had to take off my shirt. The doctor told me to take good care of my health.

scenario: Mišo kupuje nábytok do svojej izby
scenarioEn: Mišo buying furniture for his room
text: Mišo chce kúpiť nábytok do svojej novej izby. Ešte nemá nič vhodné doma. Nikto mu nepomáha s výberom. V obchode nikdy nevidel taký krásny stôl. Nakoniec si nekúpil nič lacné, len kvalitný nábytok.
textEn: Mišo wants to buy furniture for his new room. He still does not have anything suitable at home. Nobody helps him with the choice. In the shop he had never seen such a beautiful table. In the end he did not buy anything cheap, only quality furniture.

scenarioEn: Johanna's morning routine at the student dormitory
text: Johanna sa ráno zobudí o siedmej hodine. Rýchlo vstane a ide do kúpeľne. Umyje si zuby a osprchovuje sa. Potom si oblečie čisté oblečenie a zje raňajky. Ona bývа na internáte so svojou kamarátkou.
textEn: Johanna wakes up in the morning at seven o'clock. She quickly gets up and goes to the bathroom. She brushes her teeth and showers. Then she puts on clean clothes and eats breakfast. She lives in the dormitory with her friend.

text: Vonku prší a my sa nudíme doma. Ráno som si uvaril horúcu kávu a sadol som si k oknu. Deti sa hrajú s hračkami v obývačke. Neskôr sa oblečieme a pôjdeme do kina. Celá rodina sa teší na dobrý film.
textEn: Outside it is raining and we are bored at home. In the morning I made myself a hot coffee and sat down by the window. The children are playing with toys in the living room. Later we will get dressed and go to the cinema. The whole family is looking forward to a good film.

scenario: víkend v dedine u starých rodičov
text: Minulý víkend sme boli u starých rodičov na dedine. Dedina je malá, ale veľmi tichá a pekná. Starý otec má veľkú záhradu so starými stromami. Babička varila teplú polievku a čerstvý chlieb. Bolo nám tam dobre, lebo vzduch bol čistý a svieži.
textEn: Last weekend we were at our grandparents' in the village. The village is small, but very quiet and beautiful. Grandfather has a big garden with old trees. Grandmother cooked warm soup and fresh bread. We felt good there, because the air was clean and fresh.

text: Marianna varí večeru pre svojich priateľov. Pomáha jej jej kamarátka Zuzka. Marianna hovorí o nich s láskou. Varenie ju veľmi baví. Priateľov pozýva k sebe domov každý piatok.
textEn: Marianna is cooking dinner for her friends. Her friend Zuzka helps her. Marianna speaks about them with love. Cooking pleases her a lot. She invites her friends to her place every Friday.

text: Mišo chodí na univerzitu každý deň autobusom. Na prednáške sedí vedľa svojho kamaráta Petra. Po prednáške píše poznámky v zošite. Poobede číta zaujímavú knihu v knižnici. Večer sa rozpráva so spolužiakmi o skúškach.
textEn: Mišo goes to university every day by bus. At the lecture he sits next to his friend Peter. After the lecture he writes notes in a notebook. In the afternoon he reads an interesting book in the library. In the evening he talks with classmates about exams.

text: Dnes je daždivá sobota v Bratislave. Ráno som sa pozrela z okna a videla som šedé nebo. Rozhodla som sa zostať doma s knihou. Celý deň som čítala a pila horúci čaj. Bola som spokojná s týmto pokojným dňom.
textEn: Today is a rainy Saturday in Bratislava. In the morning I looked out the window and saw a grey sky. I decided to stay home with a book. All day I read and drank hot tea. I was satisfied with this peaceful day.

scenario: telefonát medzi Carlom a jeho rodinou
scenarioEn: a phone call between Carlo and his family
text: Carlo volá domov každý večer o siedmej. Hovorí s mamou a s bratom cez telefón. Rozpráva im o svojej práci v meste. Mama sa pýta na jeho zdravie a byt. Carlo sa teší na návštevu pred Vianocami.
textEn: Carlo calls home every evening at seven. He speaks with his mum and brother over the phone. He tells them about his work in the city. His mum asks about his health and flat. Carlo is looking forward to a visit before Christmas.

text: Mišo sa ráno zobudí o siedmej hodine. Rýchlo sa obleče a naraňajkuje sa. Na prednáške si robí poznámky a pýta sa učiteľa. Poobede sa stretáva s kamarátmi v jedálni. Večer sa učí a pripravuje sa na skúšky.
textEn: Mišo wakes up in the morning at seven o'clock. He quickly gets dressed and has breakfast. At the lecture he takes notes and asks the teacher questions. In the afternoon he meets his friends in the canteen. In the evening he studies and prepares for exams.

scenario: Róbert sa sťahuje do nového bytu
scenarioEn: Róbert moving to a new flat
text: Róbert sa sťahuje do nového, malého bytu v centre mesta. Starý byt bol veľký, ale nový je malý. Ulica je tichá, nie hlučná. Róbert je šťastný, nie smutný. Nové susedstvo je pekné a priateľské.
textEn: Róbert is moving into a new, small flat in the city centre. The old flat was big, but the new one is small. The street is quiet, not noisy. Róbert is happy, not sad. The new neighbourhood is nice and friendly.

scenario: telefonický rozhovor medzi Carlom a jeho rodinou
scenarioEn: a phone call between Carlo and his family
text: Carlo telefonuje so svojou milou rodinou každý večer. Jeho mama sa pýta, ako sa má jej milý syn. Carlo hovorí, že jeho nový byt je veľký a pekný. Otec chce vedieť o jeho novej práci v meste. Carlo je rád, že počuje ich známe hlasy.
textEn: Carlo calls his dear family every evening. His mom asks how her dear son is doing. Carlo says that his new apartment is big and nice. His father wants to know about his new job in the city. Carlo is glad to hear their familiar voices.

scenario: Róbertov prvý deň v novej firme
scenarioEn: Róbert's first day at a new company
text: Róbert dnes nastúpil do novej firmy. Ráno prišiel skoro a stretol svojich nových kolegov. Šéf mu ukázal kanceláriu a vysvetlil jeho úlohy. Róbert sa cítil trochu nervózny, ale kolegovia boli veľmi milí. Popoludní dostal prvú úlohu a hneď začal pracovať.
textEn: Róbert started at a new company today. In the morning he came early and met his new colleagues. The boss showed him the office and explained his tasks. Róbert felt a little nervous, but the colleagues were very nice. In the afternoon he received his first task and immediately started working.

text: Mišo vstáva každý deň o siedmej hodine. Raňajkuje rýchlo a potom ide na prednášku. Na obede jedáva v školskej jedálni so spolužiakmi. Večer sa učí v knižnici a číta poznámky. Spí asi osem hodín každú noc.
textEn: Mišo gets up every day at seven o'clock. He has breakfast quickly and then goes to a lecture. For lunch he eats in the school canteen with classmates. In the evening he studies in the library and reads his notes. He sleeps about eight hours every night.

text: Zajtra ráno Johanna vstane o siedmej. Potom si dá sprchu a oblečie sa. Na raňajky bude jesť jogurt a chlieb. Po raňajkách pôjde na prednášku. Večer sa vráti domov a bude čítať.
textEn: Tomorrow morning Johanna will get up at seven. Then she will take a shower and get dressed. For breakfast she will eat yogurt and bread. After breakfast she will go to a lecture. In the evening she will come home and will read.

text: Mišo sa ráno zobudil a rýchlo sa obliekol. Potom išiel autobusom na univerzitu a stretol kamarátov. Na obed jedol polievku v jedálni. Večer sa vrátil domov a urobil úlohy. Bol veľmi unavený, ale spokojný.
textEn: Mišo woke up in the morning and quickly got dressed. Then he went by bus to university and met his friends. For lunch he ate soup in the canteen. In the evening he returned home and did his homework. He was very tired but satisfied.

text: V našej triede nie sú žiadni cudzinci. Nikto z nás nehovorí po čínsky. Moja spolužiačka nikdy nechodí neskoro. Nepoznám nikoho z Talianska. Nemáme žiadne problémy s komunikáciou.
textEn: In our class there are no foreigners. None of us speaks Chinese. My classmate never comes late. I don't know anyone from Italy. We have no problems with communication.

text: Stojím na nástupišti a čakám na môj vlak. Vlak má hodinovú meškanie a ja som z toho nervózny. Hovorím so svojou kamarátkou o tomto probléme. Ona je so mnou na stanici a pomáha mi. Nakoniec vlak príde a my naň nastúpime.
textEn: I am standing on the platform and waiting for my train. The train is an hour late and I am nervous about it. I am talking with my friend about this problem. She is with me at the station and is helping me. Finally the train arrives and we board it.

text: Mišo chodí na univerzitu každý deň autobusom. Má prednášky s dobrými profesormi ráno. Po prednáškach ide do knižnice učiť sa. Obeduje v školskej jedálni so spolužiakmi. Večer sa vracia domov unavený.
textEn: Mišo goes to university every day by bus. He has lectures with good professors in the morning. After lectures he goes to the library to study. He has lunch in the school canteen with classmates. In the evening he returns home tired.

scenarioEn: Maja looking for a part-time job
text: Maja ešte nenašla brigádu, ale už poslala veľa životopisov. Ešte nevolali z žiadnej firmy, ale Maja už nevzdáva. Minulý týždeň už bola na jednom pohovore, ale ešte nedostala odpoveď. Maja dúfa, že brigádu čoskoro nájde.
textEn: Maja has not yet found a part-time job, but she has already sent many CVs. No company has called yet, but Maja is not giving up. Last week she already had one interview, but she has not yet received a reply. Maja hopes she will find a job soon.

scenarioEn: Maja looking for a part-time job
text: Maja hľadá svoju prvú brigádu. Chce pracovať v malom obchode alebo v dobrej reštaurácii. Jej nová práca musí byť blízko jej domu. Každý deň posiela svoje životopisy rôznym firmám. Je veľmi usilovná študentka.
textEn: Maja is looking for her first part-time job. She wants to work in a small shop or in a good restaurant. Her new job must be near her house. Every day she sends her CVs to various companies. She is a very diligent student.

scenario: Róbert sa sťahuje do nového bytu
scenarioEn: Róbert moving to a new flat
text: Budúci týždeň sa Róbert presťahuje do nového bytu. Pomôžu mu kamaráti a spoločne prenesú všetky veci. Róbert si kúpi nový nábytok a zariadí obývačku. Bude bývať sám, ale nebude sa nudiť. Určite sa mu bude páčiť jeho nový domov.
textEn: Next week Róbert will move into a new flat. His friends will help him and together they will carry all the things. Róbert will buy new furniture and furnish the living room. He will live alone but he will not be bored. He will surely like his new home.

text: Dnes je sobota a vonku prší celý deň. Ľudia nesú dáždniky a rýchlo chodia po ulici. Ja sedím doma a pijem horúci čaj. Moja sestra číta knihu a nechce ísť von. Vonku je zima, ale doma je nám dobre.
textEn: Today is Saturday and it is raining outside all day. People carry umbrellas and walk quickly along the street. I sit at home and drink hot tea. My sister reads a book and does not want to go outside. It is cold outside, but we feel good at home.

text: Cez víkend pôjdem k starým rodičom na dedinu. Babička bude variť gulášovú polievku a dedko bude pracovať v záhrade. Pomôžem babičke s umývaním riadu. Večer si prečítame starú knihu pri krbe. Veľmi sa na to teším!
textEn: This weekend I will go to my grandparents' village. Grandma will be cooking goulash soup and grandpa will be working in the garden. I will help grandma with washing the dishes. In the evening we will read an old book by the fireplace. I am really looking forward to it!

scenarioEn: a weekend trip to the mountains
text: Cez víkend sme išli do hôr. Nikto z nás nebol unavený, hoci sme veľa chodili. Na vrchole sme nevideli nič okrem hmly. Nikdy som nezažil tak krásny západ slnka. Domov sme sa vrátili šťastní a spokojní.
textEn: Over the weekend we went to the mountains. Nobody from us was tired, although we walked a lot. At the top we saw nothing but fog. I have never experienced such a beautiful sunset. We returned home happy and satisfied.

scenario: Róbert sa sťahuje do nového bytu
scenarioEn: Róbert moving to a new flat
text: Róbert sa sťahuje do nového bytu. Má veľa krabíc s oblečením a nábytkom. Nový byt je v peknom meste. Je spokojný so svojím novým bytom. Zavolal kamarátov na pomoc so sťahovaním.
textEn: Róbert is moving to a new flat. He has many boxes with clothes and furniture. The new flat is in a nice city. He is satisfied with his new flat. He called friends to help with the move.

scenarioEn: Maja looking for a part-time job
text: Maja sa zaujíma o prácu v kaviarni. Každý deň si prezerá inzeráty na internete. Chce si nájsť brigádu na víkend. Bojí sa, že nenájde nič vhodné. Nakoniec sa rozhodne zavolať do reštaurácie.
textEn: Maja is interested in a job in a café. Every day she browses ads on the internet. She wants to find a part-time job for the weekend. She is afraid that she will not find anything suitable. In the end she decides to call a restaurant.

text: Môj nový byt je v centre mesta. Bývam na treťom poschodí s výťahom. Obývačka je pred spálňou a kuchyňa je za rohom. Hovorím o byte každý deň s kamarátmi. Som veľmi spokojná vo svojom novom byte.
textEn: My new apartment is in the city centre. I live on the third floor with an elevator. The living room is in front of the bedroom and the kitchen is around the corner. I talk about the apartment every day with friends. I am very happy in my new apartment.

scenario: víkend u starých rodičov na dedine
text: Každý víkend jazdíme k starým rodičom na dedinu. Starká varí výborný guľáš a dedko pracuje v záhrade. Ráno pijeme čaj a jeme chlieb s maslom. Večer sedíme pri ohni a rozprávame sa. Všetci sa veľmi tešíme na tento víkend.
textEn: Every weekend we drive to our grandparents in the village. Grandma cooks excellent goulash and grandpa works in the garden. In the morning we drink tea and eat bread with butter. In the evening we sit by the fire and chat. We are all very much looking forward to this weekend.

scenario: víkend v dedine u starých rodičov
text: Cez víkend sme išli do dediny k starým rodičom. Bývajú v malej dedine za mestom. S babičkou sme varili polievku a piekli koláče. Večer sme sedeli pred domom a rozprávali sa. Bolo nám tam veľmi dobre.
textEn: Over the weekend we went to the village to our grandparents. They live in a small village outside the town. With grandma we cooked soup and baked cakes. In the evening we sat in front of the house and talked. We felt very good there.

text: Marianna varí večeru v kuchyni pre svojich priateľov. Ide do obchodu pre čerstvú zeleninu a mäso. Varí polievku s cesnakom a mrkvou. Pred večerou prestrie stôl pre šiestich hostí. Priatelia prídu o siedmej hodine večer.
textEn: Marianna is cooking dinner in the kitchen for her friends. She goes to the store for fresh vegetables and meat. She cooks soup with garlic and carrots. Before dinner she sets the table for six guests. The friends will come at seven o'clock in the evening.

text: Môj nový byt je krásny. Každý deň vstávam o siedmej ráno. Na obed idem domov o pol jednej. Večer sa vraciam domov štvrť na osem. Spím do pol ôsmej cez víkend.
textEn: My new apartment is beautiful. Every day I get up at seven in the morning. I go home for lunch at half past twelve. In the evening I come home at quarter to eight. I sleep until half past seven on weekends.

scenario: telefonický rozhovor medzi Carlom a jeho rodinou
scenarioEn: a phone call between Carlo and his family
text: Carlo zavolá rodičom zajtra večer. Bude rozprávať o svojom živote v Bratislave. Mama sa bude pýtať, či bude jesť dobre. Otec povie, že príde na návštevu budúci mesiac. Carlo sa veľmi bude tešiť na stretnutie s rodinou.
textEn: Carlo will call his parents tomorrow evening. He will talk about his life in Bratislava. Mom will ask whether he will eat well. Dad will say that he will come to visit next month. Carlo will really look forward to meeting his family.

text: V mojej triede sú študenti z rôznych krajín. Zajtra budeme spolu pracovať na projekte. Moja spolužiačka Ana príde zo Španielska a predstaví sa nám. Potom sa naučíme niečo nové o iných kultúrach. Budeme sa rozprávať po anglicky aj po slovensky.
textEn: In my class there are students from various countries. Tomorrow we will work together on a project. My classmate Ana will come from Spain and will introduce herself to us. Then we will learn something new about other cultures. We will talk in English and also in Slovak.

scenario: víkend v dedine u starých rodičov
text: Minulý víkend sme išli k starým rodičom na dedinu. Babička už upiekla koláče, keď sme prišli. Dedko ešte pracoval v záhrade a bol unavený. Ja som ešte nikdy nevidel také veľké jablká. Večer sme už všetci spali o deviatej.
textEn: Last weekend we went to our grandparents' village. Grandma had already baked cakes when we arrived. Grandpa was still working in the garden and was tired. I had never yet seen such big apples. In the evening we were all already asleep by nine.

scenarioEn: a weekend trip to the mountains
text: Cez víkend pôjdeme s kamarátmi do hôr. Budeme spať v malej chate a budeme variť večeru. Ráno vyjdeme na vysoký vrch a uvidíme krásny výhľad. Potom si oddýchneme a budeme sa rozprávať pri ohni. Domov sa vrátime v nedeľu večer.
textEn: Over the weekend we will go to the mountains with friends. We will sleep in a small cottage and we will cook dinner. In the morning we will climb a high peak and we will see a beautiful view. Then we will rest and we will chat by the fire. We will return home on Sunday evening.

scenarioEn: a weekend trip to the mountains
text: Minulý víkend sme išli s kamarátmi do hôr. Vstali sme skoro ráno a zbalili sme batohy. Na vrchole sme jedli sendviče a pili čaj. Počasie bolo krásne, tak sme sa veľa fotografovali. Domov sme sa vrátili unavení, ale šťastní.
textEn: Last weekend we went to the mountains with friends. We got up early in the morning and packed our backpacks. At the top we ate sandwiches and drank tea. The weather was beautiful, so we took many photos. We returned home tired but happy.

text: Vonku prší a nikto nechce ísť von. Dnes ráno sme nevideli nikoho na ulici. V parku nie je nikdy takéto ticho. Mám doma teplý čaj a nič iné nepotrebujem. Nikde nie je krajšie ako doma pri daždi.
textEn: Outside it is raining and nobody wants to go out. This morning we saw nobody on the street. In the park it is never this quiet. I have warm tea at home and I need nothing else. Nowhere is it nicer than at home in the rain.

text: Včera večer som si sadla k stolu a otvorila učebnicu. Celý večer som sa učila nové slovíčka a gramatiku. Moja kamarátka mi pomohla s výslovnosťou. Spolu sme sa pripravili na skúšku zo slovenčiny. Ráno som išla do školy a nebála som sa.
textEn: Yesterday evening I sat down at the table and opened the textbook. All evening I studied new vocabulary and grammar. My friend helped me with pronunciation. Together we prepared for the Slovak exam. In the morning I went to school and was not afraid.

text: Zajtra mám ťažkú skúšku zo slovenčiny. Celý večer sedím pri stole a učím sa nové slovíčka. Mám otvorenú knihu a dlhý zoznam slov. Slovenčina je ťažký, ale zaujímavý jazyk. Som unavená, ale chcem dostať dobrú známku.
textEn: Tomorrow I have a difficult Slovak exam. I sit at the table all evening and study new vocabulary. I have an open book and a long list of words. Slovak is a difficult but interesting language. I am tired, but I want to get a good grade.

scenarioEn: Zuzana and Johanna at a café
text: Zuzana a Johanna sedia v kaviarni a pijú kávu. Zuzana si objednáva tortu, pretože má rada sladké. Johanna chce čaj a hovorí, že je unavená. Kamarátky sa smejú a rozprávajú sa o práci. Veľmi dobre sa cítia v tejto útulnej kaviarni.
textEn: Zuzana and Johanna are sitting in a café and drinking coffee. Zuzana orders a cake because she likes sweets. Johanna wants tea and says that she is tired. The friends laugh and talk about work. They feel very good in this cozy café.

scenario: Mišo kupuje nábytok do svojej izby
scenarioEn: Mišo buying furniture for his room
text: Mišo sa rozhodol kúpiť nábytok do svojej izby. Páčila sa mu jedna pekná posteľ a stôl. Pozrel si každý kus nábytku veľmi pozorne. Nakoniec si vybral posteľ a policu. Tešil sa na svoju novú izbu.
textEn: Mišo decided to buy furniture for his room. He liked one beautiful bed and a table. He looked at each piece of furniture very carefully. In the end he chose a bed and a shelf. He was looking forward to his new room.

text: Tento týždeň je veľmi chladno. Vonku prší a fúka silný vietor. V noci je teplota pod nulou. Ráno idem do práce s dáždnikom. Dúfam, že cez víkend bude slnečno.
textEn: This week it is very cold. Outside it is raining and a strong wind is blowing. At night the temperature is below zero. In the morning I go to work with an umbrella. I hope that over the weekend it will be sunny.

text: Včera som sa rozhodla usporiadať oslavu menín pre moju sestru. Zavolala som kamarátom a pozvala som ich na večierok. Kúpila som tortu a červené kvety. Sestra sa veľmi potešila a objala ma. Všetci sme sa dobre bavili.
textEn: Yesterday I decided to organize a name day celebration for my sister. I called friends and invited them to a party. I bought a cake and red flowers. My sister was very pleased and hugged me. We all had a good time.

scenarioEn: Zuzana and Johanna at a café
text: Zuzana a Johanna už sedeli v kaviarni. Čašník im ešte nepriniesol kávu. Zuzana si už objednala zákusok, ale Johanna ešte nevedela, čo chce. Nakoniec Johanna tiež objednala tortu. Dievčatá sa už cítili veľmi dobre.
textEn: Zuzana and Johanna were already sitting in the café. The waiter had not yet brought them coffee. Zuzana had already ordered a pastry, but Johanna still didn't know what she wanted. In the end, Johanna also ordered a cake. The girls already felt very good.

scenario: Róbert sa sťahuje do nového bytu
scenarioEn: Róbert moving to a new flat
text: Róbert sa sťahuje do nového bytu. Jeho nový byt je veľký a svetlý. Má svoje vlastné izby a modernú kuchyňu. Pomáhajú mu jeho dobrí kamaráti. Róbert je so svojím novým bytom veľmi spokojný.
textEn: Róbert is moving to a new flat. His new flat is big and bright. It has its own rooms and a modern kitchen. His good friends are helping him. Róbert is very happy with his new flat.

text: Marianna varí večeru pre svojich priateľov. V kuchyni krája zeleninu a mäso. Jej priatelia sedia v obývačke a čakajú. Marianna je veľmi dobrá kuchárka. Všetci sú hladní a tešia sa na jedlo.
textEn: Marianna is cooking dinner for her friends. In the kitchen she is chopping vegetables and meat. Her friends are sitting in the living room and waiting. Marianna is a very good cook. Everyone is hungry and looking forward to the food.

text: Včera večer Marianna varila večeru pre priateľov. Nakúpila zeleninu a mäso na trhu. Jej kamarátka Jana jej pomohla pri varení. Spolu uvarili polievku a pečené kura. Priatelia prišli o siedmej a všetko zjedli.
textEn: Yesterday evening Marianna cooked dinner for her friends. She bought vegetables and meat at the market. Her friend Jana helped her with the cooking. Together they cooked soup and roast chicken. The friends came at seven and ate everything.

scenario: a cinema evening that goes wrong
scenarioEn: A cinema evening that goes wrong
text: Kúpili sme päť lístkov na film o siedmej hodine. V kine boli len dve voľné miesta v prvom rade. Traja kamaráti museli stáť celý film. Po filme sme čakali dve hodiny na autobus. Bola to skutočne zlá noc pre šesť ľudí.
textEn: We bought five tickets for a film at seven o'clock. In the cinema there were only two free seats in the first row. Three friends had to stand through the whole film. After the film we waited two hours for the bus. It was truly a bad night for six people.

scenario: Róbert sa sťahuje do nového bytu
scenarioEn: Róbert moving to a new flat
text: Róbert sa sťahuje do nového bytu v centre mesta. Pomáha mu kamarát s veľkými krabicami. Nový byt je pred parkom a vedľa obchodu. Róbert je rád, že býva v modernom byte. Večer sa posadí za stôl a odpočíva.
textEn: Róbert is moving into a new flat in the city centre. A friend helps him with big boxes. The new flat is in front of the park and next to the shop. Róbert is glad that he lives in a modern flat. In the evening he sits down at the table and rests.

text: Johanna sedí pri stole a píše email svojej rodine. Opisuje svojmu kamarátovi nové mesto a pekné miesta. V emaily píše o škole a o svojich učiteľoch. Rodičom hovorí, že sa jej tu páči. Pošle email večer pred spaním.
textEn: Johanna sits at the table and writes an email to her family. She describes the new city and nice places to her friend. In the email she writes about school and her teachers. She tells her parents that she likes it here. She will send the email in the evening before going to sleep.

text: Johanna býva na veľkom internáte v centre mesta. Jej izba je malá, ale útulná. Ráno vstáva skoro a ide do spoločnej kúpeľne. Potom si dáva teplú kávu a čerstvý chlieb. Je unavená, ale šťastná, že má dobrých spolubývajúcich.
textEn: Johanna lives in a big dormitory in the city centre. Her room is small but cosy. In the morning she gets up early and goes to the shared bathroom. Then she has a warm coffee and fresh bread. She is tired but happy that she has good roommates.

text: Tento týždeň bolo počasie veľmi premenlivé. V pondelok ešte svietilo slnko a bolo teplo. V stredu už pršalo celý deň a bolo chladno. Vo štvrtok sme ešte videli slnko, ale len ráno. Teraz v piatok už fúka silný vietor.
textEn: This week the weather was very changeable. On Monday the sun was still shining and it was warm. On Wednesday it was already raining all day and it was cold. On Thursday we still saw the sun, but only in the morning. Now on Friday the wind is already blowing strongly.

text: Zajtra má moja kamarátka Zuzka narodeniny. Chcem jej kúpiť pekný darček. Išiel som s ním do obchodu. Premýšľal som o nej celý deň. Nakoniec som ju stretol pri pokladni a prezradil som jej všetko.
textEn: Tomorrow my friend Zuzka has her birthday. I want to buy her a nice present. I went to the store with him. I thought about her all day. In the end I met her at the checkout and told her everything.

text: Tento týždeň je počasie veľmi premenlivé. V pondelok bolo slnko a obloha bola čistá. V utorok prišiel silný dážď s vetrom. Dnes chodíme do práce v teplých kabátoch. Zajtra čakáme príjemné počasie s teplým slnkom.
textEn: This week the weather is very changeable. On Monday there was sun and the sky was clear. On Tuesday a strong rain came with wind. Today we go to work in warm coats. Tomorrow we expect pleasant weather with warm sunshine.

scenario: a cinema evening that goes wrong
scenarioEn: A cinema evening that goes wrong
text: Minulý piatok sme išli do kina s kamarátmi. Kúpili sme si lístky, ale film sa už začal. Ja som zabudol telefón doma a nič som nevidel. Kamarátka Zuzka plakala, pretože stratila kabelku. Domov sme šli pešo, lebo autobus neišiel.
textEn: Last Friday we went to the cinema with friends. We bought tickets, but the film had already started. I forgot my phone at home and saw nothing. Our friend Zuzka cried because she lost her handbag. We went home on foot because the bus did not run.

text: Vlak má hodinu meškanie. Budem čakať na perón a budem piť kávu. Možno príde o pätnásť minút. Zavolám mame a poviem jej, že mešká. Potom si sadnem a budem čítať knihu.
textEn: The train is one hour late. I will wait on the platform and I will drink coffee. Maybe it will come in fifteen minutes. I will call mum and tell her it is late. Then I will sit down and read a book.

scenarioEn: Zuzana and Johanna at a café
text: Zuzana a Johanna sedia v kaviarni. Zuzana objedná pre ne dve kávy. Johanna hovorí s ňou o svojej práci. Čašník prinesie im koláč a oni sú veľmi rady. Potom idú domov spolu s kamarátkou.
textEn: Zuzana and Johanna are sitting in a café. Zuzana orders two coffees for them. Johanna talks with her about her work. The waiter brings them a cake and they are very happy. Then they go home together with a friend.

scenarioEn: Carlo ordering lunch at the canteen
text: Carlo ide dnes do jedálne na obed. Čašníčka sa ho pýta, čo si dá. Carlo si vyberie polievku a hovorí jej o svojich preferenciách. Ona mu prinesie polievku so syrom. Carlo je spokojný s ňou a ďakuje jej.
textEn: Carlo goes to the canteen today for lunch. The waitress asks him what he will have. Carlo chooses soup and tells her about his preferences. She brings him soup with cheese. Carlo is satisfied with it and thanks her.

scenario: Carlo ordering lunch at the canteen
scenarioEn: Carlo ordering lunch at the canteen
text: Carlo dnes ide do jedálne na obed. Vezme si polievku a hlavné jedlo. Bude čakať pri pokladni a zaplatí kartou. Vypije celú polievku, lebo bude veľmi hladný. Potom si dá kávu a pôjde späť do práce.
textEn: Carlo is going to the canteen today for lunch. He will take soup and a main course. He will wait at the till and pay by card. He will drink the whole soup because he will be very hungry. Then he will have a coffee and go back to work.

text: Môj nový byt je v centre mesta. Som veľmi spokojná so svojím novým bytom. V obývačke mám pohodlnú posteľ a veľký stôl. Každý deň varím v mojej malej kuchyni. Bývam tu s kamarátkou a sme šťastné.
textEn: My new apartment is in the city centre. I am very happy with my new apartment. In the living room I have a comfortable bed and a big table. Every day I cook in my small kitchen. I live here with a friend and we are happy.

text: Minulý mesiac som sa presťahovala do nového bytu. Byt som našla cez internet a hneď som ho videla. Môj priateľ mi pomohol priniesť nábytok. Bývala som pred tým v starom podnájme, ale nový byt sa mi páčil oveľa viac.
textEn: Last month I moved into a new apartment. I found the apartment on the internet and I saw it right away. My boyfriend helped me bring the furniture. I used to live in an old rental, but I liked the new apartment much more.

text: Moja trieda začína o ôsmej ráno. Prestávka je o pol desiatej. Obed máme štvrť na jednu. Angličan Tom chodí na slovenčinu o siedmej večer. Poľka Marta príde na hodinu o pol štvrtej.
textEn: My class starts at eight in the morning. The break is at half past nine. We have lunch at a quarter to one. The Englishman Tom goes to Slovak class at seven in the evening. The Polish girl Marta will come to the lesson at half past three.

scenario: Carlo ordering lunch at the canteen
scenarioEn: Carlo ordering lunch at the canteen
text: Carlo ide do jedálne, ale nikdy nezabúda zobrať si peňaženku. V jedálni nie je nikto, kto by mu pomohol. Carlo si vyberie polievku, ale nič iné si neobjedná. Čašník mu neprinesie nič navyše bez platby. Carlo nikdy neprosí o zľavu.
textEn: Carlo goes to the canteen, but he never forgets to take his wallet. In the canteen there is nobody who would help him. Carlo chooses soup, but he won't order anything else. The waiter won't bring him anything extra without payment. Carlo never asks for a discount.

scenario: víkend v dedine u starých rodičov
text: Minulý víkend som navštívil starých rodičov na dedine. Starý otec mal v záhrade päť veľkých stromov. Babička upiekla štyri chutné koláče pre celú rodinu. Na lúke sme videli dve malé jahňatá. Strávili sme tam tri krásne dni a bolo nám veľmi dobre.
textEn: Last weekend I visited my grandparents in the village. Grandpa had five big trees in the garden. Grandma baked four tasty cakes for the whole family. In the meadow we saw two small lambs. We spent three beautiful days there and felt very well.

scenario: Róbert sa sťahuje do nového bytu
scenarioEn: Róbert moving to a new flat
text: Róbert sa chce presťahovať do nového bytu. Musí zbaliť všetky svoje veci a nábytok. Môže požiadať kamarátov o pomoc so sťahovaním. Nechce platiť veľa peňazí za prenájom. Musí podpísať zmluvu s majiteľom bytu.
textEn: Róbert wants to move to a new flat. He must pack all his things and furniture. He can ask friends for help with moving. He does not want to pay a lot of money for rent. He must sign a contract with the owner of the flat.

scenario: Róbert's first day at a new company
scenarioEn: Róbert's first day at a new company
text: Róbert nastúpil do novej práce. Prvý deň prišiel do kancelárie o ôsmej ráno. Obedoval so šéfom o pol druhej. Popoludní mal poradu od štvrť na tri do piatej. Domov odišiel o šiestej večer, unavený ale spokojný.
textEn: Róbert started a new job. On the first day he arrived at the office at eight in the morning. He had lunch with his boss at half past one. In the afternoon he had a meeting from quarter to three until five. He left for home at six in the evening, tired but satisfied.

scenario: Mišo kupuje nábytok do svojej izby
scenarioEn: Mišo buying furniture for his room
text: Mišo chce zariadiť svoju novú izbu. Kúpil dve stoličky a jeden stôl. V obchode videl päť obrazov na stenu. Vzal tiež tri police na knihy. Celkovo minul sto dvadsať eur.
textEn: Mišo wants to furnish his new room. He bought two chairs and one table. In the shop he saw five pictures for the wall. He also took three shelves for books. In total he spent one hundred and twenty euros.

scenario: víkend v dedine u starých rodičov
text: Cez víkend sme išli k starým rodičom na dedinu. Babička varila polievku s čerstvou zeleninou. Dedko nás vzal do záhrady a ukázal nám stromy. Hrali sme sa s malým psom pred domom. Boli sme veľmi spokojní s celým víkendom.
textEn: During the weekend we went to our grandparents' village. Grandma cooked soup with fresh vegetables. Grandpa took us to the garden and showed us the trees. We played with a small dog in front of the house. We were very happy with the whole weekend.

scenario: Róbert's first day at a new company
scenarioEn: Róbert's first day at a new company
text: Dnes je Róbertov prvý deň v novej firme. Jeho nová šéfka je veľmi milá žena. Róbert má vlastný stôl a moderný počítač. Všetci kolegovia sú priateľskí a ochotní pomôcť. Róbert je rád, že má takú dobrú prácu.
textEn: Today is Róbert's first day at the new company. His new boss is a very kind woman. Róbert has his own desk and a modern computer. All the colleagues are friendly and willing to help. Róbert is glad that he has such a good job.

scenarioEn: Johanna's morning routine at the student dormitory
text: Johanna býva na internáte s dobrou kamarátkou. Ráno vstáva o siedmej hodine a ide do kúpeľne. Umýva si tvár studenou vodou a čistí zuby. Potom raňajkuje v jedálni s ostatnými študentmi. Dnes má Johanna prednášku o ôsmej hodine.
textEn: Johanna lives in a dormitory with a good friend. In the morning she gets up at seven o'clock and goes to the bathroom. She washes her face with cold water and brushes her teeth. Then she has breakfast in the dining hall with the other students. Today Johanna has a lecture at eight o'clock.

text: Môj nový byt je veľký a svetlý. Kuchyňa je malá, ale útulná. Obývačka má vysoký strop a široké okná. Spálňa nie je tmavá, je veľmi jasná. Celkovo som so svojím novým bytom veľmi spokojná.
textEn: My new apartment is big and bright. The kitchen is small but cozy. The living room has a high ceiling and wide windows. The bedroom is not dark, it is very bright. Overall I am very happy with my new apartment.

scenarioEn: A cinema evening that goes wrong
text: Chceli sme ísť do kina, ale nemohli sme kúpiť lístky. Museli sme čakať hodinu pred pokladňou. Potom sme nechceli sedieť vzadu, lebo sme nevideli dobre. Nakoniec sme museli odísť domov bez filmu.
textEn: We wanted to go to the cinema, but we couldn't buy tickets. We had to wait an hour in front of the ticket office. Then we didn't want to sit in the back because we couldn't see well. In the end we had to leave for home without the film.

text: Zajtra má moja sestra meniny. Chcem jej kúpiť krásne kvety a sladkú tortu. Oslavu organizujeme v našom byte s priateľmi. Budeme spievať, tancovať a rozprávať sa do noci. Teším sa na túto radostnú oslavu s celou rodinou.
textEn: Tomorrow is my sister's name day. I want to buy her beautiful flowers and a sweet cake. We are organizing the celebration in our apartment with friends. We will sing, dance and talk until night. I am looking forward to this joyful celebration with the whole family.

scenarioEn: Maja looking for a part-time job
text: Maja hľadá brigádu v meste. Zaujíma sa o prácu v kaviarni. Hovorí s kamarátkou o svojich plánoch. Chce pracovať pred vyučovaním, ráno. Pôjde do práce po škole.
textEn: Maja is looking for a part-time job in the city. She is interested in working in a café. She talks with a friend about her plans. She wants to work before classes, in the morning. She will go to work after school.

text: Dnes ráno o ôsmej hodine prší. Poobede od pol druhej svieti slnko. Zajtra ráno bude hmlisto od štvrť na sedem. V stredu o polnoci bude snežiť. Cez víkend od pol šiestej ráno bude teplo.
textEn: This morning it is raining at eight o'clock. In the afternoon from half past one the sun shines. Tomorrow morning it will be foggy from a quarter to seven. On Wednesday at midnight it will snow. Over the weekend from half past five in the morning it will be warm.

scenario: Mišo kupuje nábytok do svojej izby
scenarioEn: Mišo buying furniture for his room
text: Mišo chce zariadiť svoju novú izbu. Ide do veľkého obchodu s nábytkom. Kúpi si bielu posteľ a malý stôl. Jeho nová izba bude veľmi pekná. Mišo je so svojím novým nábytkom spokojný.
textEn: Mišo wants to furnish his new room. He goes to a big furniture store. He buys a white bed and a small table. His new room will be very nice. Mišo is happy with his new furniture.

scenarioEn: Maja looking for a part-time job
text: Maja hľadá brigádu, lebo si chce zarobiť peniaze. Zajtra bude volať do kaviarne a opýta sa na voľné miesto. Ak dostane prácu, bude pracovať cez víkend. Dúfa, že si nájde dobrú brigádu čoskoro.
textEn: Maja is looking for a part-time job because she wants to earn money. Tomorrow she will call a café and ask about a free position. If she gets the job, she will work on weekends. She hopes she will find a good part-time job soon.
